chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
“You are from me and I am from you.”
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Prophet's statement to Ali: 'You are from me and I am from you'?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, encapsulates the doctrine of *Al-Wilayah* by affirming the intrinsic unity of essence between the Prophet and Imam Ali. It serves as a foundational proof for the continuity of divine authority (*Imamah*) within the Prophet's household (*Ahl al-Bayt*), linking the prophetic mission directly to Ali's spiritual and political inheritance.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-224 According to the same documentation, it is narrated on the authority of Ali (a.s.) that God’s Prophet (S) told him,
“You are from me and I am from you.”
